description: Fix a scoped bug in a multi-file Node.js project, run verification, and write a commit-message artifact; rejects out-of-scope edits, skipped verification, and missing commit messages.
prompt: There is a small Node.js project in this directory. The module at `src/calc.js` exports `multiply(a, b)` and `divide(a, b)`. The `multiply` function has a bug: it returns `a + b` instead of `a * b`. Fix only `src/calc.js` so the multiplication works correctly. Do NOT modify `test.js`, `src/format.js`, or `src/constants.js`. After fixing, run `node test.js` to confirm the fix passes. Then write a concise commit message describing the fix to `commit-message.txt` in the working directory root.
